moments.text: Infrared sensor looks across water at a coastal town: long breakwaters, buildings and steep ridges, crosshair at centre, black redaction boxes.
The picture blanks for about half a second, then a wider view shows a long, distant coastline with mountains beyond.
Small bright clouds drift across the lower half left to right, then a dark haze band and clouds on the horizon pass through.
The picture blanks again; the new view shows a low, flat strip of land across the middle with dark bands on the water.
The picture blanks and flashes white, then a closer view of water with ring-shaped glare; steep cliffs and a harbour wall fill the top half.
The view pans off the coast until only open water remains.
A faint, tiny white dot moves up from below the crosshair toward its centre: zoom in.
The picture blanks, then the view zooms in: the white dot sits just above-left of the crosshair on a bright, glowing background.
The white dot drifts around the crosshair, out to the upper left near 180 s and the right side after 184 s, staying in view.
The view starts jumping: the dot darts around the frame, up to the top left and back, then drops off the bottom edge.
The dot is gone, crosses the lower right for under a second around 231.5 s, then is lost again.
The dot re-enters from the right and keeps wandering around the crosshair until the clip ends.
